I don't have a confirmed 2027 price from Corvane. The only figure is an internal assumption: the Q1 2027 pricing memo assumes the Corvane per-item ACH fee stays at $0.08 in 2027 [11]. That is a planning number, not a quote.

The current agreement runs until March 31, 2027, and Marcus is opening renewal talks in November [11]. On Nov 16, Marcus said Corvane hinted they want to raise the per-item fee after the Nov 10 file rejection, but nothing is on paper yet [14]. The memo predates that hint, so the $0.08 assumption may not hold. The memo also says that if the fee goes above $0.10, the bottom pricing tier should be revisited [11].
